description: Clean precision pilot: selects the final replicate count mechanically under the rule locked in experiments/precision/replicate_rule_v1.json (python/replicate_decision.py), before any final data. All five primary geometries x n in {500, 2000, 10000} x both primary densities {8, 12} (never pooled), 52 independent graphs per cell (ladder 20/28/36/44/52, each a multiple of 4 so Williams positions are exactly balanced at every prefix). Measurement protocol identical to the final study (CGAL, Williams order, 5 timed repetitions + 1 warmup). Run under the machine-preparation checklist. Pilot outcomes may inform the protocol; final outcomes may not.
